description.searchText: Healing Signet Signet Warrior Tactics Signet. You gain Health. You have -40 armor while using this skill.

Signet of Capture Signet Signet. Choose one skill from a nearby dead Boss of your profession. Signet of Capture is permanently replaced by that skill. If that skill was elite, gain 250 XP for every level you have earned.

Power Block Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Elite Spell. If target foe is casting a spell or chant, that skill and all skills of the same attribute are disabled ( seconds) and that skill is interrupted.
Mantra of Earth Stance Mesmer Inspiration Magic Stance. ( seconds.) Reduces earth damage you take by . You gain 2 Energy when you take earth damage.
Mantra of Flame Stance Mesmer Inspiration Magic Stance. ( seconds.) Reduces fire damage you take by . You gain 2 Energy when you take fire damage.
Mantra of Frost Stance Mesmer Inspiration Magic Stance. ( seconds.) Reduces cold damage you take by . You gain 2 Energy when you take cold damage.
Mantra of Lightning Stance Mesmer Inspiration Magic Stance. ( seconds.) Reduces lightning damage you take by . You gain 2 Energy when you take lightning damage.
Hex Breaker Stance Mesmer Domination Magic Stance. ( seconds.) The next hex against you fails and the caster takes damage.
Distortion Stance Mesmer Illusion Magic Stance. ( second[s].) You have 75% chance to block. Block cost: you lose 2 Energy or Distortion ends.
Mantra of Recovery Stance Mesmer Fast Casting Elite Stance. ( seconds.) Your spells recharge 33% faster.
Mantra of Persistence Stance Mesmer Inspiration Magic Stance. ( seconds.) Illusion hexes you cast last longer.
Mantra of Inscriptions Stance Mesmer Inspiration Magic Stance. ( seconds.) Signets you successfully activate while in this stance recharge faster.
Mantra of Concentration Stance Mesmer Inspiration Magic Stance. ( seconds.) The next time you would be interrupted, you are not interrupted.
Mantra of Resolve Stance Mesmer Inspiration Magic Stance. ( seconds.) Prevents interrupts against you. Prevention cost: lose Energy or Mantra of Resolve ends.
Mantra of Signets Stance Mesmer Inspiration Magic Stance. ( seconds.) You have +3 armor for each signet. You gain health each time you use a signet.
Fragility Hex Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target ( seconds). These foes take damage each time they gain or lose a condition.
Inspired Enchantment Spell Mesmer Inspiration Magic Spell. Removes an enchantment from target foe. Removal effects: you gain Energy; this spell is replaced with that enchantment (20 seconds).
Inspired Hex Spell Mesmer Inspiration Magic Spell. Removes a hex from target ally. Removal effects: you gain Energy; this spell is replaced with that hex (20 seconds).
Power Spike Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: deals damage.
Power Leak Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: causes Energy loss.
Power Drain Spell Mesmer Inspiration Magic Spell. Interrupts a spell or chant. Interruption effect: you gain Energy.
Empathy Hex Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Target foe's attacks deal less damage, and that foe takes damage with each attack.
Shatter Delusions Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Spell. Removes a Mesmer hex from target foe. Removal effect: damage to target and 75% of that damage to all adjacent foes.
Backfire Hex Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Target foe takes damage whenever it casts a spell.
Blackout Touch skill Mesmer Domination Magic Touch Skill. ( seconds.) Disables skills. Your skills are disabled (5 seconds).
Diversion Hex Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Hex Spell. (6 seconds.) Target foe's next skill takes seconds to recharge.
Conjure Phantasm Hex Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Causes -5 Health degeneration.
Illusion of Weakness Enchantment Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Enchantment Spell. Lose Health. End effect: you gain Health. Ends if damage drops your Health below 25% of your maximum.

Illusionary Weaponry Enchantment Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Elite Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals damage to foes in place of other damage or effects from melee attacks. You have +5 armor for each equipped Illusion Magic skill. Your melee attacks neither hit nor fail to hit.
Sympathetic Visage Enchantment Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Enchantment Spell. ( seconds.) All adjacent foes lose all adrenaline and 3 Energy whenever a melee attack hits target ally.
Ignorance Hex Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Target foe cannot use signets.

Arcane Conundrum Hex Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target ( seconds). Doubles spell casting time. End effect: you gain energy. Unlike other skill descriptions, "energy" is lowercase here
Illusion of Haste Enchantment Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Enchantment Spell. ( seconds.) You move 33% faster. Initial effect: removes Crippled condition. End effect: you are Crippled (3 seconds).
Channeling Enchantment Spell Mesmer Inspiration Magic Enchantment Spell. ( seconds.) You gain 1 Energy for each foe in the area whenever you cast a spell.
Energy Surge Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Elite Spell. Causes Energy loss. Deals 7 damage to target for each point of Energy lost and 75% of that damage to nearby foes.
Ether Feast Spell Mesmer Inspiration Magic Spell. Causes 3 Energy loss. You gain Health for each point of Energy lost.
Ether Lord Hex Spell Mesmer Inspiration Magic Hex Spell. You lose all Energy. Target foe has Energy degeneration and you have Energy regeneration ( seconds).
Energy Burn Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Spell. Causes Energy loss. Deals 9 damage for each point of Energy lost.
Clumsiness Hex Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Hex Spell. (4 seconds.) Also hexes adjacent foes. Interrupts next attack. Interruption effect: deals damage.
Phantom Pain Hex Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Causes Health degeneration. End effect: inflicts Deep Wound condition ( seconds).
Ethereal Burden Hex Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Target foe moves 50% slower. End effect: you gain Energy.
Guilt Hex Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Hex Spell. (6 seconds.) Target foe's next spell fails and you steal Energy. No effect unless this foe's spell targets one of your allies.

Ineptitude Hex Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Elite Hex Spell. (4 seconds.) Also hexes foes adjacent to target. Deals damage. Inflicts Blindness condition (10 seconds). No effect unless hexed foe attacks.
Spirit of Failure Hex Spell Mesmer Inspiration Magic Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Target foe has 25% chance to miss. You gain Energy whenever this foe misses.

Mind Wrack Hex Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Causes 1 Energy loss each time foe is the target of your non-hex Mesmer skills. Deals damage per point of Energy lost. If target foe's Energy drops to 0, it takes damage and Mind Wrack ends.

Wastrel's Worry Hex Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Hex Spell. (3 seconds). End effect: causes damage to target and 75% of that damage to adjacent foes. No effect and ends early if target foe uses a skill.
Shame Hex Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Hex Spell. (6 seconds.) Target foe's next spell fails and you steal Energy. No effect unless this foe's spell targeted one of its allies.
Panic Hex Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near your target ( second[s]). Interrupts all other nearby foes whenever a hexed foe successfully activates a skill.
Migraine Hex Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Elite Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Causes Health degeneration and doubles skill activation time.
Crippling Anguish Hex Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Elite Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Target foe moves and attacks 50% slower and has Health degeneration.

Fevered Dreams Hex Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Elite Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Foes in the area also have any new conditions that target foe acquires. Inflicts Dazed on target foe ( second[s]) if that foe has two or more conditions.
Soothing Images Hex Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Hex Spell. Also hexes foe adjacent to target. ( seconds). These foes cannot gain adrenaline.

Cry of Frustration Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Spell. If target foe is using a skill, that foe and all foes in the area are interrupted. Foe suffers damage and foes in the area take 75% of that damage.
Signet of Midnight Touch Signet Mesmer Elite Touch Signet. (15 seconds.) Inflicts Blindness condition. You suffer from Blindness (15 seconds).
Signet of Weariness Signet Mesmer Domination Magic Signet. Also affects foes near your target. Causes Energy loss and inflicts Weakness ( second[s]).
Leech Signet Signet Mesmer Inspiration Magic Signet. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: you gain Energy if the action was a spell.
Signet of Humility Signet Mesmer Inspiration Magic Signet. Disables elite skill ( second[s]). Disables your non-Mesmer skills (4 seconds).

Keystone Signet Signet Mesmer Fast Casting Elite Signet. (20 seconds.) Your next signet[s] interrupt Should be "interrupts" when it affects 1 signet and deal damage to other foes adjacent to your target. Initial Effect: "Effect" is capitalized unlike most other descriptions with "Initial effect" recharges all of your other signets.
Arcane Mimicry Spell Mesmer Spell. This skill becomes target ally's elite skill (20 seconds). Cannot self-target. No effect if target's elite skill is a form.
Spirit Shackles Hex Spell Mesmer Inspiration Magic Hex Spell. (). Target foe loses 5 Energy whenever it attacks.
Shatter Hex Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Spell. Removes a hex from target ally. Removal effect: deals damage to foes near this ally.
Drain Enchantment Spell Mesmer Inspiration Magic Spell. Removes an enchantment from target foe. Removal effect: you gain Energy and Health.
Shatter Enchantment Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Spell. Removes an enchantment from target foe. Removal effect: deals damage.
Elemental Resistance Stance Mesmer Inspiration Magic Stance. ( seconds.) You have +40 armor against elemental damage. You have armor against physical damage.
Physical Resistance Stance Mesmer Inspiration Magic Stance. ( seconds.) You have +40 armor against physical damage. You have armor against elemental damage.
Echo Enchantment Spell Mesmer Elite Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Echo becomes the next skill you use (30 seconds).
Arcane Echo Enchantment Spell Mesmer Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) Arcane Echo becomes the next spell you use (20 seconds). This enchantment ends if you use any skill that is not a spell.
Imagined Burden Hex Spell Mesmer Illusion Magic Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Target foe moves 50% slower.
Chaos Storm Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Spell. Deals damage and causes Energy loss each second (10 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.
Epidemic Spell Mesmer Spell. Conditions on target foe transfer to adjacent foes.
Energy Drain Spell Mesmer Inspiration Magic Elite Spell. Causes Energy loss. You gain 3 Energy for each point of Energy lost.
Energy Tap Spell Mesmer Inspiration Magic Spell. Causes Energy loss. You gain 2 Energy for each point of Energy lost.
Arcane Thievery Spell Mesmer Domination Magic Spell. ( seconds.) Disables one random spell. This skill becomes that spell.
Mantra of Recall Enchantment Spell Mesmer Inspiration Magic Elite Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) End effect: you gain Energy.
Animate Bone Horror Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. Creates a level bone horror. Exploits a fresh corpse.
Animate Bone Fiend Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. Creates a level bone fiend that can attack at range. Exploits a fresh corpse.
Animate Bone Minions Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. Creates two level bone minions. Exploits a fresh corpse.

Grenth's Balance Spell Necromancer Elite Spell. You gain Health equal to half the difference between you and target, and this foe loses an equal amount. If this foe has less Health than you, you lose Health equal to half the difference.

Verata's Gaze Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. Make target undead servant masterless. If it is already masterless, you become its master and heal it for . 50% failure chance unless Death Magic 5 or more.

Verata's Aura Enchantment Spell Necromancer Death Magic Enchantment Spell. ( seconds.) Become master of all hostile undead servants in the area. End effect: your undead servants become masterless. 50% failure chance unless Death Magic 5 or more.
Deathly Chill Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. Deals cold damage. Deals more damage if target foe was above 50% Health.

Verata's Sacrifice Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. ( seconds.) 10 undead allied servants gain +10 Health regeneration. Instantly recharges if you have control of 3 or fewer servants. Transfers all conditions from those servants to you.

Well of Power Well Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Elite Well Spell. ( seconds.) Allies in this well have Health regeneration and +2 Energy regeneration. Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.
Well of Blood Well Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Well Spell. ( seconds.) Allies in this well have Health regeneration. Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.
Well of Suffering Well Spell Necromancer Death Magic Well Spell. ( seconds.) Foes in this well have Health degeneration. Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.

Well of the Profane Well Spell Necromancer Death Magic Well Spell. ( seconds.) Foes in this well lose all enchantments and cannot be the target of further enchantments. Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health. 50% failure chance unless Death Magic 5 or more.
Putrid Explosion Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. Explodes a corpse, dealing damage to foes near it. Exploits a fresh corpse.
Soul Feast Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. You gain Health. Exploits a fresh corpse.

Necrotic Traversal Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. Exploit a random corpse or sacrifice health to teleport to target foe's location. You become Diseased for 6 seconds and all nearby foes become Poisoned for second[s].
Consume Corpse Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. Teleport to a corpse's location. You gain Health and Energy. Exploits a fresh corpse.
Parasitic Bond Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Hex Spell. (20 seconds.) Causes -1 Health degeneration. End effect: you are healed for Health.
Soul Barbs Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals damage when an enchantment or hex is cast on target foe.
Barbs Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Target foe takes damage whenever it takes physical damage.
Shadow Strike Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Spell. Deals damage. Steal up to Health if this foe was above 50% Health.
Price of Failure Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) 25% chance to miss. Target foe takes damage whenever it fails to hit.
Death Nova Enchantment Spell Necromancer Death Magic Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals damage and inflicts Poisoned condition (15 seconds) on adjacent foes if target ally dies.
Deathly Swarm Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. Deathly Swarm flies out slowly and deals cold damage. Hits two additional foes in the area.
Rotting Flesh Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. Inflicts Diseased condition ( seconds).
Virulence Spell Necromancer Death Magic Elite Spell. Inflicts Disease, Poison, and Weakness conditions ( seconds). No effect unless this foe already had a condition.
Suffering Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near target ( seconds). These foes have Health degeneration.
Life Siphon Hex Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Target foe has Health degeneration. You have Health regeneration.
Unholy Feast Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Spell. Steals Health from foe[s] in the area around you.
Awaken the Blood Enchantment Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Enchantment Spell. ( seconds.) You have +2 Blood Magic and Curses. Sacrifice 50% more Health than normal.
Desecrate Enchantments Spell Necromancer Curses Spell. Deals damage to target and nearby foes. Deals more damage for each enchantment on them.
Tainted Flesh Enchantment Spell Necromancer Death Magic Elite Enchantment Spell. ( seconds.) Foes who hit allies in the area in melee become Diseased ( seconds); this ally is immune to Disease.

Aura of the Lich Enchantment Spell Necromancer Death Magic Elite Enchantment Spell. Exploit all corpses in earshot. Animates a level bone horror, plus one for each exploited corpse. You have +1 Death Magic ( seconds).
Blood Renewal Enchantment Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Enchantment Spell. (7 seconds.) You have Health regeneration. End effect: heals you for .
Dark Aura Enchantment Spell Necromancer Death Magic Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds). Deals damage to adjacent foes whenever target ally sacrifices Health. Damage cost: you lose Health.
Enfeeble Spell Necromancer Curses Spell. Inflicts Weakness condition ( seconds).
Enfeebling Blood Spell Necromancer Curses Spell. Inflicts Weakness condition ( seconds) on this foe and nearby foes.
Blood is Power Enchantment Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Elite Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) Energy regeneration. Cannot self-target.
Blood of the Master Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. Heals your undead servants for . Healing cost: +2% Health sacrifice per servant healed.
Spiteful Spirit Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Elite Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Deals damage to target and adjacent foes whenever this foe attacks or uses a skill.

Malign Intervention Hex Spell Necromancer Death Magic Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Target foe receives 20% less from healing. If this foe dies while suffering from this hex, a level masterless bone horror is summoned.
Insidious Parasite Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Steal Health whenever target foe hits with an attack.
Spinal Shivers Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Cold damage interrupts target foe's skills. Interruption cost: you lose Energy or Spinal Shivers ends.

Wither Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Elite Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Causes Health degeneration and -1 Energy degeneration. Deals damage if target foe's Energy drops to 0. Ends if this foe's Energy drops to 0.
Life Transfer Hex Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target ( second). Causes Health degeneration. You have Health regeneration.
Mark of Subversion Hex Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Hex Spell. (6 seconds.) Target foe's next spell fails and you steal Health. No effect unless this foe's spell targeted one of its allies.
Soul Leech Hex Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Elite Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Steal Health whenever target foe casts a spell.
Defile Flesh Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Reduces healing target foe receives by 33%. Only skills with the word "heal" in the description are affected.
Demonic Flesh Enchantment Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Enchantment Spell. ( seconds.) When using a skill on a foe, deal shadow damage to all other foes adjacent to you.
Barbed Signet Signet Necromancer Blood Magic Signet. Target and adjacent foes suffer from Bleeding ( seconds).
Plague Signet Signet Necromancer Curses Elite Signet. Transfers all conditions with of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. 50% failure chance unless Curses 5 or more.
Dark Pact Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Spell. Deals damage.
Order of Pain Enchantment Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Enchantment Spell. Enchants all party members (5 seconds). more damage whenever these party members hit with physical damage.
Faintheartedness Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Target foe attacks 50% slower and has Health degeneration.
Shadow of Fear Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target ( seconds). They attack 50% slower.
Rigor Mortis Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Target foe cannot block.
Dark Bond Enchantment Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Enchantment Spell. ( seconds.) Transfers 75% of incoming damage from you to your nearest servant.
Infuse Condition Enchantment Spell Necromancer Death Magic Enchantment Spell. ( seconds.) Whenever you receive a condition, it transfers from you to your closest undead servant.

Malaise Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Causes -1 Energy degeneration. Deals damage if target foe's Energy drops to 0. You have -1 Health degeneration. Ends if this foe's Energy drops to 0.
Rend Enchantments Spell Necromancer Curses Spell. Removes enchantments from target foe. Removal cost: you lose Health for each Monk enchantment removed.
Lingering Curse Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Elite Hex Spell. ( seconds.) Target and nearby foes have Health degeneration and receive 25% less benefit from healing.
Strip Enchantment Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Spell. Removes enchantment[s] from target foe. Removal effect: you steal Health.
Chilblains Spell Necromancer Curses Spell. Deals cold damage to foes in the area around your target; removes enchantment[s] from these foes. You are Poisoned (10 seconds).
Signet of Agony Signet Necromancer Blood Magic Signet. Deals damage to foes near you. You begin Bleeding (25 seconds).
Offering of Blood Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Elite Spell. You gain Energy.

Dark Fury Enchantment Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Enchantment Spell. Enchants party members (5 seconds). These party members gain one strike of adrenaline each time they hit with an attack. 50% failure chance unless Blood Magic 5 or more.

Order of the Vampire Enchantment Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Elite Enchantment Spell. Enchants all party members (5 seconds.) These party members steal Health with each physical damage attack. Party members under another Necromancer enchantment are not affected.
Plague Sending Spell Necromancer Curses Spell. Transfer condition[s] and [its/their] remaining duration[s] from yourself to target foe and all adjacent foes.
Mark of Pain Hex Spell Necromancer Curses Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals damage to adjacent foes whenever target foe takes physical damage.
Feast of Corruption Spell Necromancer Curses Elite Spell. Deals damage to target and adjacent foes. Steal Health from each hexed foe.
Taste of Death Spell Necromancer Death Magic Spell. Steals Health from allied undead servant.
Vampiric Gaze Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Spell. Steals Health.
Plague Touch Touch skill Necromancer Curses Touch Skill. Transfers condition[s] from yourself to target foe.
Vile Touch Touch Skill Necromancer Death Magic Touch Skill. Deals damage.
Vampiric Touch Touch Skill Necromancer Blood Magic Touch Skill. Steals Health.
Blood Ritual Touch Enchantment Spell Necromancer Blood Magic Enchantment Spell. ( seconds.) +3 Energy regeneration. Cannot self-target.
